eyebrow: Family food, seasoning and export-ready production

story.title: Family food, then food-safety discipline, then export.
story.body: Sanfood traces its story to 2017 and positions the business around family-friendly food, local agricultural ingredients and progressively stronger production standards. Its public profile highlights Halal, BPOM, GMP and HACCP milestones alongside regular Middle East exports.

highlights.title: Family-first formulation
highlights.body: Sanfood presents products around practical family nutrition, cleaner formulations and everyday cooking.

highlights.title: Certified production
highlights.body: Its public company profile lists Halal, BPOM, GMP, PSAT, Green Label and HACCP milestones.

highlights.title: Local ingredients
highlights.body: The brand story emphasizes working with Indonesian agricultural ingredients and local supply.

highlights.title: Export ambition
highlights.body: Sanfood describes a move from domestic family food into recurring Middle East export activity.
